# Ravella Ultra Solution Organic Wine

> Ravella Ultra Solution Organic Wine is a sugar-free, non-alcoholic herbal wellness drink made in Nigeria. It contains noni root, neem, senna and papaya extracts in pH 8.5 alkaline water, sold in 750 ml bottles for ₦20,000 each, with delivery across Nigeria. NAFDAC Reg. No. A7-103154L (listed).

Last updated: 3 November 2026

## Key facts
- Product name: Ravella Ultra Solution Organic Wine (also called Ravella Ultra, Ravella Ultra Organic Wine)
- Type: herbal wellness drink; non-alcoholic despite the word "wine" in its name; sugar-free
- Bottle size: 750 ml
- Made in: Nigeria
- NAFDAC: listed herbal product, registration number A7-103154L
- Ingredients: alkaline water pH 8.5 (50%), noni root / Morinda citrifolia (20%), neem / Azadirachta indica (10%), senna / Senna alata (10%), papaya / Carica papaya (10%)
- How to take (adults): shake well; 30 ml after meals, morning and evening; drink a glass of warm water about 10 minutes later; maximum 60 ml per day
- One bottle lasts about 12 days at the recommended amount

## What people use it for
Adults take Ravella Ultra as part of a daily wellness routine. The ingredients are traditionally used to support energy and stamina (noni), the body's natural defences (noni, neem), internal cleansing and regularity (neem, senna; senna is a natural laxative), digestion (papaya) and hydration (alkaline water). It is a wellness drink, not a medicine, and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

## Who should not take it
Children; pregnant or breastfeeding women; anyone allergic to noni, neem, senna or papaya. People with a medical condition or on medication should ask their doctor first and should not stop prescribed medicine.

## Distributor advantage
Under the Ravella Ultra compensation plan, distributors can earn:
- retail profit of up to 25% (₦5,000 per bottle resold at ₦20,000)
- a 26% direct referral bonus, plus an indirect referral bonus
- a binary pairing bonus of ₦4,608 per completed pair (daily limits depend on the package)
- an upgrade bonus, plus repurchase rebates and bonuses
- rank awards (cash, cars, international travel) and monthly global profit sharing
- leadership, matching and royalty bonuses
- a brand outlet and an outlet referral bonus

Earnings depend on sales and are not guaranteed.

## Delivery
- All 36 Nigerian states and the FCT, including Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Kano, Benin City, Warri, Enugu, Kaduna and Owerri
- Lagos: usually 24–48 hours; other states: usually 2–4 days
- International: UK, USA, Canada, Ghana and selected European countries. DHL takes 3–5 business days for under 24 bottles; cargo takes 10–15 working days for 24 bottles or more.
